about_the_game:
Flex hooks is a minimalist puzzler with a simple mechanics: just move the hooks to activate all the buttons.

Key features

  • Minimalist design
  • Relaxing environment
  • No time pressure
  • Chill game
  • Handcrafted levels
  • Steam achievements
